question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS yr 
  FROM Movie 
  WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
films_per_year AS (
  SELECT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Movie 
  WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER)
),
periods AS (
  SELECT y.yr AS start_year, SUM(COALESCE(f.cnt, 0)) AS total_films
  FROM years y
  LEFT JOIN films_per_year f ON f.yr BETWEEN y.yr AND y.yr + 9
  GROUP BY y.yr
)
SELECT CAST(start_year AS INTEGER) AS start_year, CAST(total_films AS INTEGER) AS total_films
FROM periods
ORDER BY total_films DESC
LIMIT 1
